item.title: The purpose of loaning players
item.description: Motherwell, a team who have won plaudits for playing out from the back this season, based that strategy on Celtic loanee Stephen Welsh (25) in central defence. Who saw that coming? item.title: TRANSFER OBSTACLE COURSE: ‘IT’S DOWN TO ME,’ ADMITS O’NEILL
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL insists Celtic are “working really hard” in this transfer window in an effort to strengthen the squad. But the interim boss, preparing for the Premiership meeting at Falkirk tomorrow night, acknowledged it is an obstacle course to try to get the right players in place at a vitally important stage of the crusade. item.title: FALKIRK v CELTIC: 5-MINUTE QUIZ
item.description: CELTIC are aiming to complete a hat-trick of wins over Falkirk when the teams meet in the Premiership this evening. The Hoops knocked out the newly-promoted team from the Premier Sports League Cup with a 4-1 success in August and followed that up with a 4-0 league victory in late October, both encounters at Parkhead.
